understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move in 3-pixel grid increments. CLICK selects a selectable piece using its pixel coordinates, while directional moves shift the selected piece unless blocked. Adjacent pushable blocks can be pushed, walls or boundaries may prevent movement, and movement hints are not always definitive, so actions may need to be tested.
